scientific_gap: The primary v2 calibration envelope perturbs major nuisance mechanisms mostly one at a time. Control under each atomic regime does not imply control when nuisance mechanisms co-occur. In particular, the locked signal study already evaluates signals on all 25 cadences while several non-Gaussian or misspecified noise regimes are calibrated only on ordinary cadences, so a successful v2 must not be read as evidence for arbitrary cadence-by-noise interactions.
purpose: Prospectively stress the final frozen v2 statistic and threshold on a small, mechanism-driven set of compound null nuisances without changing candidate selection, calibration, locked promotion gates, or the interpretation of the primary v2 result.

execution_timing.earliest_allowed: Only after locked_evaluation_complete exists and the selected statistic implementation plus threshold are frozen.
execution_timing.ordering: Run after the primary locked evaluation and before or after the original three generalization probes; results may not feed back into any v2 decision.
execution_timing.retuning: No candidate, threshold, template bank, nuisance parameter, cadence, error vector, or promotion gate may be changed in response to this extension.

rng_contract.independence: This seed is separate from the frozen development, calibration, locked-evaluation, cadence, and bootstrap seeds.
rng_contract.canonicalization: Stable JSON with all fields present; trial_index is zero-based within probe_id x cadence_id.
rng_contract.seed_derivation: payload = UTF8(str(extension_seed) + '\n' + canonical_key_json); digest = SHA256(payload); seed_words are the first 16 digest bytes interpreted as four unsigned big-endian 32-bit integers; use PCG64(SeedSequence(seed_words)).
rng_contract.collision_rule: Reject duplicate canonical keys before generating any curve.

probes.generation: Use each frozen seasonal-gap time array and reported-error vector. Generate zero-mean Gaussian residuals with Corr(i,j)=0.7^abs(i-j) by sorted observation index, scaled by the frozen reported errors.

Use each frozen seasonal-gap time array. Generate independent Gaussian residuals with true standard deviation 1.5 times the frozen reported errors while the search still receives the uninflated reported errors.

Generate zero-mean Gaussian residuals with Corr(i,j)=0.7^abs(i-j) by sorted observation index and marginal standard deviation 1.5 times the frozen reported error; the search receives the uninflated reported errors.
Generate AR(1) rho=0.7 Gaussian residuals scaled by the frozen reported errors, then choose one epoch uniformly and add +6 times that epoch's reported error.
Generate independent Student-t(3)/sqrt(3) residuals and multiply by 1.5 times the frozen reported errors; the search receives the uninflated reported errors.

Generate independent Gaussian residuals with variance multiplier 1 for times <=30 days and 2 for times >30 days, scaled by the frozen reported errors, then choose one epoch uniformly and add +6 times that epoch's reported error.

analysis.threshold: Apply the already frozen selected-statistic threshold unchanged to every probe.
analysis.detection_rule: Use the same v2 locked detection comparison as the selected statistic; do not jitter ties.
analysis.simultaneous_diagnostic: For the six extension probes, use one-sided exact-binomial upper bounds with Bonferroni family-wise alpha 0.05/6. This is descriptive/secondary and is not a v2 promotion gate.
analysis.interpretive_flag: Flag any probe with point false-alarm fraction >0.01 as a compound-nuisance failure. The flag constrains claims but does not retroactively change the frozen primary v2 pass/fail decision.

claim_rules.if_any_probe_fails: A primary v2 success may still be reported exactly as an atomic-envelope synthetic qualification, but the manuscript must state that robustness did not extend to all prespecified compound nuisances tested here and must name the failed probes.
claim_rules.if_all_probes_pass: The study may additionally report control on these six prespecified compound-nuisance probes. It may not claim robustness to arbitrary nuisance combinations, target-survey systematics, or real-sky completeness.
claim_rules.negative_results: Every extension result is retained and reported; no failing probe may be removed, reparameterized, or rerun with a changed threshold.

non_modification_statement: This extension changes no v2 candidate, seed, cadence, reported-error vector, atomic null regime, signal design, calibration rule, threshold, primary endpoint, promotion gate, or original generalization probe. It is a separately identified secondary post-lock stress study frozen before any v2 performance outcome is observed.
